content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) provides a basic infrastructure for deploying a digital commerce stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) builds upon this foundation, adding Supabase for order storage and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for enhanced security. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers a comprehensive guide to building and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack, with full source code and NOWPayments integration guide. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) bundles all six blueprints and seven templates for instant access to everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Kenyan creators can leverage Binance P2P, which supports Kenyan shillings, to accept payments in local currencies. This, combined with the use of NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, provides a seamless payment experience for international buyers. By using these tools, creators can bypass traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which are restricted in many countries. This infrastructure allows creators to tap into the global market, unhindered by geographical restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an attractive option for fast and cost-effective transactions. NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, with no additional costs for setup, maintenance, or customization. In contrast, traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal charge hefty fees, often upwards of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, making them much more expensive than the infrastructure solution offered by COREMERCH.
Creators can bypass traditional payment platforms and accept payments from international buyers in local currencies using NOWPayments and Binance P2P.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The infrastructure solution offered by COREMERCH provides complete ownership and control over every aspect of the digital commerce stack, from backend logic to file delivery. Automated payment processing through NOWPayments ensures seamless and secure transactions, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 provides fast and reliable file delivery to customers. This infrastructure eliminates the need for intermediaries, ensuring that creators have full control over their digital products and the revenue generated from their sales.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators looking for a basic infrastructure solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a cost-effective option. For those requiring more advanced features, such as Supabase for order storage and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a better choice. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers a comprehensive guide to building and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack, making it an ideal option for creators who want to build their own infrastructure. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the ultimate bundle for instant access to everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
